Material, texture and generator pipeline — backlog

Reference Doppio Last updated: 2026-11-20 Source: material-pipeline.md

The living checklist for materials, textures, map baking, node generators and texture sets, kept current so the next change starts from the real foundation instead of the history.

Living checklist for the Doppio material stack. Update the checkboxes as work lands; keep the current foundation section accurate so a future agent can continue without re-reading the whole history.

Clean-room rule: MaterialCraft, TextureCraft and MistyEngine under reference/ are read for public behaviour, formats and UI conventions only. Do not copy source, shader text, node definitions or bundled assets.

Current foundation (done)#

  • [x] .mat PBR assets: full MaterialSurface, presets, load/save, assign to Mesh Filter, Inspector slot, undoable scene assignment.
  • [x] Engine sphere preview (MaterialPreviewRenderer) through the C ABI with orbit drag and throttled refresh.
  • [x] Texture map utilities: normal from height (OpenGL/DirectX), AO from height, roughness/metallic from albedo, ORM, Unity HDRP mask, Unity metallic-smoothness. DirectX normals are flipped by the shader.
  • [x] Material Studio: surface/maps/UV/advanced cards, texture picker, map baker, generated-map assignment.
  • [x] Assets: texture/material/mesh/scene filter, search, image thumbnails and material albedo swatches.
  • [x] Reusable node_canvas component: graph-space nodes, typed ports, cubic wires, drag, pan, zoom, selection and connect events.
  • [x] Atomic material graph: Color, Image, Noise (value/Perlin), Voronoi, Checker, Bricks, Gradient, Blend, Levels, Curve, HSL, Threshold, Blur, Warp, Value, Luminance, Dot and Output (Color/Roughness/Metallic/Height/ AO). Typed colour/scalar ports, blend masks and 13 blend modes.
  • [x] Bake graph → base colour, height, roughness, metallic, AO, normal and packed maps; save and assign to the selected entity automatically.
  • [x] Background worker bake with progress/cancel; the UI keeps the last result and never blocks the viewport. The Generator also runs a debounced low-resolution live bake of the Output node after every graph edit.
  • [x] 8/16-bit generated maps and a channel-packing editor (ORM, Unity HDRP, Unity metallic-smoothness, custom R/G/B/A sources).
  • [x] Per-material <name>.mgraph sidecar (versioned CAFMGRAPH2 text, reads CAFMGRAPH1) with nodes, links, parameters, positions and resolution.
  • [x] MCP queries/actions and material-smoke / material-generator-smoke.

Phase 1 — Complete the generator foundation#

  • [x] Graph history, wire selection/delete/reconnect, reroute dots, palette search, 16-unit snapping, copy/paste, fit-to-graph, undo/redo MCP actions, Rust tests and the material-generator-smoke flow.

Undo/redo for graph edits — done#

  • [x] Add a graph history stack per material (snapshots or reversible commands). MaterialGraph is Clone, so snapshots are the simplest first step; keep them small and cap memory.
  • [x] Coalesce continuous edits with a stable key: generator:move:<node>, generator:param:<node>:<param>, so a drag is one step.
  • [x] Cover Add/Delete node, Connect/disconnect, Move, every parameter, output assignment, resolution and graph load/clear.
  • [x] Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z and Ctrl+Y while the Generator pane is focused; header Undo/Redo buttons remain available.
  • [x] MCP generator_undo / generator_redo plus can_undo, undo_name, can_redo, redo_name in the generator query.
  • [x] Tests: add→undo, connect→undo/redo, coalesced drag, delete link, dot, copy/paste and scene-shortcut routing.

Wire editing — first pass done#

  • [x] Hit-test cubic wires (sample the bézier; ~5 px tolerance) and keep a separate wire-selection state from node selection.
  • [x] Delete/Backspace removes a selected wire in one history step; right-click a wire and the properties-panel Delete link button do the same. Dragging a connected input detaches its source for reconnection.
  • [x] Add a reroute dot node: one input/one output, pass-through; insert on double-click of a wire or with insert_generator_dot.
  • [ ] Wire context menu and source swap of exactly two wires.
  • [ ] Hover highlight + pointer feedback; canvas redraws only on changes.
  • [x] Tests for wire hit distance, single-input replacement, cycle rejection, reroute round-trip and undo.

Canvas polish — first pass done#

  • [x] Snap node placement to a 16-unit grid; toggle in the canvas toolbox.
  • [x] Search field filters the node palette by node name or category; the palette is grouped by category in the shared tree view with collapsible groups. A Space/Tab modal search remains a future refinement.
  • [x] Copy/paste the selected node (toolbox buttons and MCP); internal-link duplication/duplicate-selection is still pending.
  • [ ] Optional frames/comments; keep them out of the first undo milestone.
  • [x] Fit-to-graph ("Fit" button / fit_generator).
  • [x] Node cards show a live 72 px thumbnail (96 px evaluated) of their own evaluated output, computed in the debounced background preview worker; errors simply omit that thumbnail and never block editing.

Phase 2 — MaterialCraft-style node library#

Image and texture nodes#

  • [x] Project texture node: pick an image asset, sample UV, expose tiling and offset; reuse the texture picker and engine path resolver.
  • [x] Image sampler node with nearest/linear and clamp/repeat.
  • [x] UV projection choices: UV, planar, tri-planar (synthetic spherical domain until mesh-space UVs are available), cylindrical and spherical.
  • [x] Normal-map input node and normal blend (whiteout/linear) for height/normal combinations.
  • [x] Image decoding runs on the bake worker; decode errors abort with a message. A 4K resolution warning remains.

More atomic generators/filters#

  • [x] Voronoi/cells with distance and cell-colour outputs.
  • [x] Perlin and value noise with octaves, persistence and lacunarity; simplex/Worley variants and anisotropic scale/rotation remain.
  • [x] Curve, levels (brightness/contrast/gamma/invert), HSL, blur and warp.
  • [x] Sharpen, emboss and directional blur.
  • [x] Threshold/soft mask, distance, edge-detect and cavity/curvature masks; dirt-like masks remain.
  • [x] Blend additions: overlay variants, soft light/hard light, subtract, difference, darken/lighten, colour dodge/burn; per-channel alpha remains.
  • [x] Scalar constants and a value node, typed colour/scalar ports; arithmetic nodes remain.
  • [ ] Function/group nodes only after the atomic graph is stable; do not add a scripting VM in this phase.

Bake and output#

  • [x] Bake on a worker thread with progress/cancel; the UI keeps the last result. Never freeze the viewport while cooking.
  • [x] 16-bit generated maps plus 8-bit PNG defaults; float cook remains.
  • [x] Channel-packing editor: destination R/G/B/A ← AO, roughness, metallic, height, smoothness, base luminance or constants; built-in ORM, Unity HDRP and Unity metallic-smoothness presets plus custom channels, saved user presets in ~/.config/caffeine/packing-presets.txt.
  • [x] AO derived from the height map and scene-geometry AO through Photon (caffeine_session_bake_ao, Material → AO from scene); displacement height bake remains.
  • [x] Graph outputs generate base, normal, roughness, metallic, AO and height maps and pack them for the material; emissive/opacity outputs remain.

Phase 3 — MaterialCraft interoperability#

  • [x] Import .mcmat: manifest, cooked maps, parameters and source.sbs → a Doppio .mat, map files, .sbs source and .mgraph sidecar.
  • [x] Parse SBS XML compNode graphs (known filter mapping for color, noise, voronoi, checker, bricks, gradient, blend, levels, HSL, threshold, blur, sharpen, emboss, directional blur, warp, edge/cavity/distance masks, normal blend, image/normal-map nodes and outputs).
  • [x] Preserve unknown filters and unsupported graph outputs as NodeKind::Unknown placeholders; keep all links and report warnings in the generator status/log.
  • [x] Portable .mcmat export first: baked maps + manifest + minimal source.sbs, with node/link round-trip validation before writing.
  • [ ] Full native SBS export parity. The current writer emits the Doppio subset and validates it against our own reader; do not claim Substance parity.
  • [x] Headless doppio-material CLI (import, import-sbs, export, bake-graph, inspect) and MCP import_materialcraft / export_materialcraft actions using the same engine-backed helpers. bake-graph <file.mgraph> [--size N] [--out DIR] prints per-stage timing and is the quickest way to reproduce a slow bake outside the editor.

Explicit node mapping#

SBS filter Doppio node Notes
uniformcolor / solidcolor Color colour parameter
noise, perlin_noise, fractal_* Noise value/Perlin, scale, octaves, seed
voronoi Voronoi scale, jitter, seed, mode
checker / checkerboard Checker scale and two colours
bricks / brick Bricks rows, columns, mortar, colours
gradient* Gradient angle and two colours
blend Blend destination/source inputs, opacity, blending mode
normal_blend Normal Blend whiteout/linear
levels, hsl, threshold/mask Levels, HSL, Threshold matching parameters
blur, sharpen, emboss, directional_blur, warp corresponding filter node radius/intensity mapped heuristically
edge_detect, curvature/cavity, distance Edge/Cavity/Distance Mask strength/threshold/radius
image / normalmap Image / Normal Map path, projection, tiling, offset, filter, wrap
value, luminance, curve, dot Value, Luminance, Curve, Dot constants/utilities
output bridge Output usage selects Color/Roughness/Metallic/Height/AO port
anything else Unknown placeholder links and port order preserved, warning reported

Known-name parameters that cannot be represented keep the node as a placeholder rather than silently dropping data. The native SBS writer covers this table and is validated by importing its own output; it is not advertised as full Substance Designer parity.

Phase 4 — TextureCraft-style texture sets and painting#

This is a separate pipeline from material graphs. Do not pretend the material map baker is a texture painter. The texture-set foundation below is implemented in uikit/texture_set.rs, uikit/panels/texture_set.rs and uikit/components/uv_canvas.rs; the unchecked items are the remaining painter depth.

  • [x] Texture sets with UDIM tiles (1001–1010), channel definitions and per-tile RGBA resources.
  • [x] Layer stack: paint/fill layers, visibility, opacity, 13 blend modes, reorder/delete and per-layer tile masks. Folder layers and thumbnails remain.
  • [x] 2D UV painting canvas, channel selection and a 3D paint mode that ray-picks the selected mesh and paints at the hit UV. Pressure/stylus input, stamp masks, projection painting and seam handling remain.
  • [x] Mesh-map bakes: AO/curvature from height, scene-AO import through Photon, and world-normal, world-position and object-ID bakes from the selected mesh UVs. Thickness and bent-normal bakes remain.
  • [x] Built-in export presets (separate maps, glTF ORM, Unity HDRP mask) and a CLI texset-export; user-defined output templates remain.
  • [x] Undo/redo from per-tile snapshots and the .texset project format (ZIP manifest + PNG tiles/masks).
  • [ ] Integration: dropped texture becomes a material; generated maps can be used by the map baker and Generator image nodes.

Phase 5 — Material rendering and asset polish#

  • [x] Preview shapes Sphere/Cube/Plane and an HDRI environment + exposure controls, rendered at 512 px with contain-fit framing; sphere remains the fast default.
  • [x] Async material preview with begin/poll readback and no UI stall. The synchronous C ABI entry point remains for tools/tests.
  • [x] Engine thumbnail decode (caffeine_texture_load_thumbnail) as the primary asset/material thumbnail path, with the Iced loader as fallback; cache entries are invalidated by file modification stamp. The GPU texture cache also hot-reloads a file whose stamp changed even while the scene or preview still holds the old pointer, retiring that texture instead of destroying it in use.
  • [x] Apply saves dirty baked materials before assignment and creates a cube preview mesh on empty entities, so masks/bricks reach the .mat file.
  • [x] Material picker in the Inspector with a searchable .mat list; internal asset drag/drop assigns materials/textures, and OS file drops work too.
  • [ ] Drag presets into the generator canvas and reorder material maps.
  • [x] glTF/OBJ material import: base color, metallic-roughness, normal, occlusion, emission, alpha and glTF UV transform into .mat + .mgraph.
  • [x] Material preview overlays: DirectX/OpenGL, alpha mode, map presence and per-map resolution/missing-file badges.
  • [x] C ABI version bumped to 2 with caffeine_capi_version() and a status bar badge; C API tests cover it.
  • [x] Foliage (C ABI 9): wind_strength (sway per metre of height above the object's origin), wind_speed, wind_flutter and translucency in the .mat, the C ABI, the Material panel and the renderer. Wind is a vertex offset applied identically in the colour, instanced and shadow vertex shaders (shadows sway with the leaves); translucency adds light through thin surfaces on the face turned away from the sun. See the Nature guide for the numbers the generator writes.

Procedural library and presets (no third-party assets needed)#

User guide with rendered images: materials-guide.md.

  • [x] uikit/procedural/: ~123 data-driven, tileable, seeded, multi-threaded ops (NodeKind::Proc) — Noise 16, Natural 17, Patterns 18, Shapes 8, Math 25, Geometry 8, Height & PBR 14, Realistic 17 (realistic.rs). Each op is one OpDef row (ports, ParamSpecs, colours, eval); the palette, properties panel, .mgraph (proc <id> …) and MaterialCraft (doppio_proc) are generated from it.
  • [x] Output node: Emissive / Opacity / Normal inputs appended after Color..AO, plus auto_height (height from base luminance when Height is unconnected), normalize_height and height_contrast, so height is never a flat plane. BakedMaterial gained emissive(16), has_emissive, opacity(16), has_opacity, normal.
  • [x] uikit/material_library.rs: 78 parameterisable presets (Stone, Brick, Concrete, Ground, Wood, Metal, Fabric, Organic, Sci-fi, Misc and the Realistic Rock/Water/Nature/Ground/Wood/Man-made families with optional accent layers and emissive wiring), picked from the generator header Library dropdown (one undoable step, resolution kept). Tests bake every preset at 64² and check base variance, height std-dev > 0.02, determinism and .mgraph round trip.
  • [x] Output preview channel switcher (Base, Normal, Height, Roughness, Metal, AO, Emissive, Opacity). Each node card shows a live 72 px thumbnail (96 px evaluated) of its own evaluated output, refreshed with the same debounced worker pass.
  • [x] Reseed button in the generator header: every seeded node (Noise, Voronoi, Warp and every procedural op with a seed parameter) gets a new seed derived from the graph; one undo step, deterministic for a given graph.
  • [ ] Preset scale / wear are not yet exposed in the UI.

World-scale plan (seed, scatter, streaming): photoreal-world-roadmap.md.

Definition of done for "the base is complete"#

  • Generator graph edit undo/redo and wire editing never lose work.
  • A material and its graph survive save/reopen, and a graph bake is reproducible byte-for-byte at the same resolution.
  • MaterialCraft import covers the node set we expose; unsupported data is reported, not dropped.
  • Texture sets/painting have their own project format and undo; material maps can consume their exports.
  • The preview and asset browser work without blocking the UI thread.
  • check-rust-ui.sh, Rust tests, [capi]/[material], and every MCP smoke pass; docs and UI captions are regenerated.

Depth, bake and height packing#

  • [x] Parallax occlusion mapping in scene_lit.frag; height in the normal map's alpha (16-sampler limit); MaterialSurface::heightScale/parallaxSteps, .mat keys, C ABI v3, Rust Material, Material panel sliders. The ray-march moves toward the camera for recessed texels (alpha 1 = surface, 0 = deepest), so pits read as depth instead of inverted peaks. POM self-shadowing applies to directional, point and spot lights; the height cavity also attenuates direct, ambient, IBL and reflected light, so the relief does not flatten into plastic when the sun is not grazing. Direct specular uses DVF without the extra PI factor that blew out highlights.
  • [x] Generator bake size is selectable at 128/256/512/1024/2048 px. 2048 is the safe max; 4K needs a tiled/parallel evaluator (the current CPU memo peaks above practical memory at 4096×4096 with 16-bit maps).
  • [x] Bake progress counts reachable nodes only and names the finalisation stages (Packing maps, Baking occlusion, Writing maps, Done). The automatic AO uses a separable box blur (O(pixels), not O(pixels × radius)), so 2K bakes finish in seconds instead of appearing stuck.
  • [x] Generator bake packs height into the normal alpha and enables depth; authored Normal / Emissive / Opacity outputs are written and wired.
  • [x] Preview cache key includes texture file stamps, and a re-bake which rewrites the same PNG paths now reloads those GPU textures in place (doppio/crates/engine/tests/material_preview.rs).
  • [x] Pack a height map into the normal… (external height images).
  • [x] Parallax self-shadowing (parallaxSelfShadow) and a derivative-based UV frame (fixes the oblique/sheared look caused by non-u-aligned procedural tangents).
  • [x] Geometric displacement: displacement_mode geometric, displacement_scale (m), mesh_subdivisions in the .mat; the mesh is midpoint-subdivided (assets/MeshSubdivide.hpp) and scene_displace.vert / shadow_displace.vert push vertices along normals by the normal-map alpha through the vertex-stage sampler (set 0, so the 16 fragment samplers are untouched). Normals are rebuilt by finite differences and the shadow pass uses the same formula, so relief casts real shadows. C ABI version 4. Material panel: "Geometric displacement" checkbox + depth + subdivisions.
  • [x] Material preview: sun direction/height/intensity and a Shadows toggle (C ABI v5, caffeine_session_set_material_preview_light, agent action set_material_preview_sun), 768 px render, closer camera, brighter floor, sky fill.
  • [x] Shadow pass is order independent (BlendMode::Min); stale shadow maps are cleared when shadows are off; POM self-shadow multiplies with the shadow-map term.
  • [x] Cross-session fix: process-wide GPU texture cache, procedural meshes and mesh cache are released on session shutdown (the device is leaked on purpose).
  • [x] Re-bake fix: GpuTextureCache reloads a file rewritten in place (stamp changed) even while its ref count is non-zero.
  • [x] UVs follow the object's scale (uv_object_scale, on by default; C ABI v6): the vertex shaders measure the model matrix's stretch along the tangent / bitangent and the fragment and displacement shaders multiply the tiled UV by it, so a scaled quad keeps its texture density. Instanced draws and the material preview keep the authored UVs. Material panel checkbox.
  • [x] Variation node class (procedural/variation.rs, 6 ops): Noise Variation (Perlin / Simplex), Cell Variation (grid, Voronoi or a pattern's own cell ids), Patch Blend, Tile Shuffle, Wave Function Collapse (overlapping model, periodic output) and Diamond-Square (toroidal). Seven Varied presets use them; also in the Texture Generator (two Procedural presets).
  • [ ] Variation: simple-tiled WFC with an explicit tile set and adjacency rules; WFC constraints (fixed cells, region masks); Diamond-Square with an erosion pass.
  • [ ] Expand culling bounds by the displacement depth; distance-adaptive subdivision.
  • [x] Preset seed in the UI (the Reseed button); scale and wear remain.

Texture Generator (separate tool, see texture-generator-guide.md)#

  • [x] Its own pane, .texgraph file (CAFTEXGRAPH1), Texture Output node (Colour + alpha, or packed R/G/B/A), palette and presets; the material and texture loaders refuse each other's files, and the material palette hides the VFX & Shapes ops.
  • [x] 10 VFX & Shapes ops (leaf, feather, droplet, shockwave ring, flame, smoke puff, sparks, radial burst, soft glow, colour ramp) and 16 presets.
  • [x] Preview over a checkerboard with Colour / Alpha / R / G / B views.
  • [x] PNG export (8 and 16 bit, straight alpha) and flipbook sheets that loop every phase parameter; doppio-material bake-texture; agent query texture_generator and actions.
  • [ ] Float / EXR output for heightmaps and LUTs.
  • [ ] Image-reader node and seamless (tiled) export mode in the Texture Generator.
  • [ ] Preset seed / colour variation in the UI; more presets (decals, runes, scratches, stylised clouds).

Nature Generator (separate tool, see nature-generator-guide.md)#

  • [x] Recipe-driven rocks (icosphere + noise + cut planes), trees (recursive tubes, broadleaf / conifer / dead) and plants (grass, fern, bush, flower); stylised / balanced / detailed quality.
  • [x] Software 3D preview, .obj export (one file per part) and .nature recipes, Place in scene as a group with one entity per part and baked materials (library presets, Texture Generator cards).
  • [x] Engine fix: propagateTransforms no longer crashes on children without a world matrix.
  • [x] Wind (vertex sway + leaf flutter, also in the shadow pass), leaf translucency, generated bark sets, leaf-card normal maps and crown-interior shading (see the guide, section 4c).
  • [x] Run-time modifiers (C ABI 10): tint, wetness, snow, age on the material and on the Mesh Renderer, applied in scene_lit.frag without re-baking; see runtime-modifiers.md.
  • [x] Alpha-tested shadows for cut-out cards, per-vertex colour (occlusion tint + painted flutter weight, read from OBJ v x y z r g b a into a second vertex stream) and GPU-instanced scatter placement.
  • [ ] Material slots per submesh (ABI), LOD / impostors, .glb writer.
  • [x] Seeded, cached variants of a nature recipe (doppio-material variants, uikit/recipe_ref.rs).
  • [ ] Scatter over terrain and biomes (belongs to the terrain generator).
